messages:
Incident Bot: paging oncall -> streaming: service detection: `streaming.sse.response_tail_delay.p99` breach (SLO 3s) :warning:

Incident Bot: alert details: p95=1.1s p99=4.9s, spike started ~3123456700, affected route: `v1/stream/respond`, approx 12% increase in client disconnects (ws) and stalled chunks observed.

Jordan (oncall): ack. I'm looking at the dashboard now, seeing a p99 tail of ~4.8s and a sustained bump in inflight requests.

Priya: noticing a lot of 504s from envoy to runtime around the same window. Could be proxy timeouts or runtime slowdowns.

Jordan (oncall): stack traces? logs?

Kevin: grabbing proxy logs. snippet: ```text
[envoy] upstream request timeout for cluster runtime-pool, per_try_timeout=15s, x-envoy-upstream-service-time=4700ms
[envoy] downstream reset due to client slow_recv
```

Sam: runtime heap growth correlated with long-context requests from a handful of clients. KV cache miss rate up ~3x which could increase per-token latency.

Jordan (oncall): looks like two factors: client backpressure -> slow_consumers holding connections -> proxy buffer growth -> upstream flush stalls. And some runtime slow paths when kv-cache thrash for >4k tokens.

Priya: quick plan: 1) reduce per_try_timeout to 5s for streaming route to fail fast and let client fallback logic kick in, 2) enable connection-level keepalive to recover stalled websockets, 3) temporarily disable prefix/KV cache for the heavy-context model variant to avoid locks.

Jordan (oncall): do we have a config command for envoy? Kevin, can you push a hotfix for route timeouts?

Kevin: on it. Pushing change: `route_config.streaming.per_try_timeout: 5s` -> rolling restart of gateway pods in staging then prod. ETA ~3m.

Runbook Bot: runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/streaming/slow-tail. Recommended mitigations: scale runtime pool, reduce batching window, adjust proxy timeouts, set fallback to chunked-polling.

Sam: scaling runtime pool by +2 nodes now. Also lowering generation batch size for `model-x` from 32 -> 8 for streaming route. That should reduce head-of-line blocking.

Jordan (oncall): applied temporary config to disable prefix cache for model-x on 2/3 runtime nodes. Rolling changes complete. Observability -> sampling indicates p99 dropped to ~2.9s after actions.

Priya: also enabling websocket keepalive (30s) at gateway to avoid slow recv stalls. Deployed.

Customer Ops: we have two customers reporting visible UI stalls (chat windows freezing). Reached out with status: "we're mitigating increased streaming latency, brief degradations possible; will update in 30m."

Jordan (oncall): monitoring for 10-15m. If metrics remain stable, we'll consider this mitigated and move to monitoring state.

Kevin: notes from envoy logs after change: upstream timeouts drop, connection resets down 70%.

Sam: runtime memory spike subsided after disabling prefix cache and reducing batch size. CPU is normal.

Priya: marking incident as partial mitigation. Still see isolated p99 spikes around heavy context sessions. Next actionable: identify top offending client sessions and throttle or advise chunked fallback.

Jordan (oncall): collecting top offenders via tracing. Query: `trace.service:streaming and trace.tag:long_context` -> results exporting now.

Jordan (oncall): handing off to Priya for continued monitoring and customer comms for the next 4 hours. Priya, you're primary.

Priya: ack, I'll take it. Will follow up with a short incident summary and customer impact table in ~30m. If p99 rebounds above 3.5s will re-escalate to Sev2.

Incident Bot: escalation policy note: oncall handoff recorded. Next oncall: Priya -> shift 3123456846 to 3123460446.

Jordan (oncall): quick postmortem action items (TL;DR):
- Add automated detection for combined proxy+runtime tail events.
- Tune default per_try_timeout heuristics for streaming routes.
- Investigate KV cache locking under heavy long-context workloads.
- Add ingress backpressure metrics for earlier alerts.

Priya: will create ticket and assign to eng-runtime (owner: Sam) and eng-platform (owner: Kevin).

Customer Ops: thanks — customers updated. We'll prepare a short status note for affected tenants.

Priya: closing current mitigation loop, moving to monitoring. Will update thread if anything regresses.

Jordan (oncall): thanks team. :thumbsup:

Runbook Bot: reminder: please file a post-incident report once stable: https://runbooks.redwood/postmortems
